# GoodTherapy

> GoodTherapy is a comprehensive mental health platform connecting patients with licensed therapists, psychiatrists, psychologists, and treatment centers across the US, Canada, and internationally.

GoodTherapy provides a therapist directory and matching service to help individuals find mental health professionals by location, specialty, insurance, and demographics. The platform also offers educational resources on therapy types, crisis support, and practice growth tools for mental health professionals.

## Key Topics

- Therapist Directory
- Mental Health Services
- Therapy Finder
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- Couples Counseling

- Psychiatrists

## Find a Therapist

- [Find the Right Therapist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-therapist.html): Location-based therapist finder by state and specialty
- [Find Therapists by Insurance](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-therapy/insurance): Find in-network therapists by insurance provider and coverage
- [Find a Marriage Counselor](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-therapy/marriage-couples-counseling): Couples and marriage counseling therapist finder
- [Find a Psychologist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-psychologists.html): Licensed psychologist directory by location and specialty
- [Find a Child Therapist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-child-therapists-counselors.html): Child therapy finder with play therapy and behavioral health
- [Find a Psychiatrist](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-psychiatrists.html): Psychiatrist directory guide and how-to resource
- [BIPOC Therapists](https://www.goodtherapy.org/find-therapy/bipoc-community.html): Culturally responsive BIPOC therapist directory
- [International Search](https://www.goodtherapy.org/international-search.html): International therapist directory search outside US and Canada

## Mental Health Support & Resources

- [Crisis Resources & Support](https://www.goodtherapy.org/in-crisis.html): Crisis resources and emergency mental health support guide
- [Find Support Groups](https://www.goodtherapy.org/workshops/support-group): Support group finder for depression, anxiety, and addiction
- [Find a Rehab Treatment Center](https://www.goodtherapy.org/treatment-centers): Rehabilitation facility finder with inpatient and outpatient care
- [Worksheet Resources](https://www.goodtherapy.org/worksheets-resources.html): Mental health worksheets and self-help therapy resources
- [How Much Does Therapy Cost?](https://www.goodtherapy.org/blog/faq/how-much-does-therapy-cost): FAQ on therapy costs, pricing, and affordability information

## Education & Learning

- [Types of Therapy](https://www.goodtherapy.org/learn-about-therapy/types): Educational guide to therapy types, approaches, and models
- [Explore Therapy and Counseling](https://www.goodtherapy.org/explore-therapy.html): Therapy and counseling overview with educational information
- [How GoodTherapy Works](https://www.goodtherapy.org/how-goodtherapy-works): Platform overview and user guide for GoodTherapy
- [GoodTherapy Blog](https://www.goodtherapy.org/blog): Blog homepage with mental health resources and therapy information

## For Therapists & Professionals

- [Join GoodTherapy Directory](https://www.goodtherapy.org/join-therapist-directory-membership.html): Therapist membership signup for practice growth and client acquisition

## Home

- [GoodTherapy Homepage](https://www.goodtherapy.org): GoodTherapy homepage: therapist directory and mental health matching
